faq

W e ’ v e G o t
A n s w e r s *

Straight answers to the questions people usually ask.

What kind of websites do you build?

Business sites, landing pages and portfolios — mostly. If a project needs real front-end work, custom layout, motion or data, that’s the kind I like best.

Can you work from an existing design?

Send over the design and I’ll build it faithfully — or start from it and suggest changes where they’d help on smaller screens.

Can you add interactions and animations?

Send over the design and I’ll build it faithfully — or start from it and suggest changes where they’d help on smaller screens.

How does your process work?

Understand the brief, design what’s missing, build it, then refine on real devices. You see progress as it happens, not at a big reveal.

Do you build responsive sites and web tools?

Everything is built mobile-first, and I’ve built interactive tools and small web products where the interface has real logic behind it.
